source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 11 (PDF 288-298), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 11 (Vector Valued Functions and Their Derivatives (TOC: '...and Their Differentiations')) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
11.1 Scalar And Vector-Valued Functions Of A Single Variable

blocks.prompt:
1 A vector-valued function of a single variable \(t\) gives as its output:
(Aik variable \(t\) ka vector-valued function output mein kya deta hai?)

options.text: aik vector, magnitude aur direction ke saath
real numbers ka aik set jis mein koi tarteeb nahin

blocks.explanation: Vector-valued function output mein vector deta hai jis ki magnitude (miqdaar) aur direction (simt) dono hoti hain; scalar function sirf aik number deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions return vectors with both magnitude and direction

blocks.prompt:
2 A particle has position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\). At \(t = -3\) it is at the point:
(Particle ki position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) hai. \(t = -3\) par yeh kis point par hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}(-3) = -3\,\hat{i} + 9\,\hat{j}\), is liye point \((-3, 9)\) hai. \((-3)^{2} = 9\) hota hai, \(-9\) nahin.

book_ref.quote: This means at time \(t\), the particle is at the point

blocks.prompt:
3 The path traced by \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) is the curve:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ka raasta (path) kaun sa curve hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 2t\) se \(t = \dfrac{x}{2}\); phir \(y = t^{2} = \dfrac{x^{2}}{4}\), yeh parabola hai.

book_ref.quote: This means at time \(t\), the particle is at the point

blocks.prompt:
4 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (3000\cos t)\hat{i} + (3000\sin t)\hat{j} + 500t\,\hat{k}\) (km, \(t\) in hours), the radius of the circle traced in the \(xy\)-plane is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = (3000\cos t)\hat{i} + (3000\sin t)\hat{j} + 500t\,\hat{k}\) (km, \(t\) ghanton mein) mein \(xy\)-plane wale circle ka radius kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 3000^{2}\), is liye radius \(3000\) km hai. \(500t\) wala hissa \(z\)-axis ke saath oopar jaana hai.

book_ref.quote: model the satellite's circular orbit in the

blocks.prompt:
5 For the same orbit \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (3000\cos t)\hat{i} + (3000\sin t)\hat{j} + 500t\,\hat{k}\), how high (in km) has it risen after one full circle, \(t = 2\pi\)?
(Isi orbit \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (3000\cos t)\hat{i} + (3000\sin t)\hat{j} + 500t\,\hat{k}\) mein aik poora chakkar (\(t = 2\pi\)) ke baad height kitni barh jati hai (km)?)

book_ref.quote: This function maps time to a position vector

blocks.prompt:
6 Which one of the following is a scalar function of \(t\)?
(In mein se \(t\) ka scalar function kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(t^{3} - \sin t\) har \(t\) ke liye aik real number deta hai, is liye scalar function hai. Baaqi sab vector dete hain.

book_ref.quote: A scalar function is a function that assigns a single real number

blocks.prompt:
7 The value of the scalar function \(f(t) = 2t - 3\cos t\) at \(t = \pi\) is:
(Scalar function \(f(t) = 2t - 3\cos t\) ki \(t = \pi\) par value kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos\pi = -1\), is liye \(f(\pi) = 2\pi - 3(-1) = 2\pi + 3\) (\(t\) radians mein).

book_ref.quote: A real-valued function is commonly called a scalar function

blocks.prompt:
8 Which one of the following quantities is a scalar?
(In mein se kaun si quantity scalar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalar ki sirf miqdaar hoti hai. Speed sirf number hai; velocity, force aur displacement ki simt bhi hoti hai, is liye woh vectors hain.

book_ref.quote: like measuring temperature at a specific point

blocks.prompt:
9 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \left\langle t^{2}, \dfrac{1}{t}, t - 1\right\rangle\), then \(\mathbf{r}(2)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \left\langle t^{2}, \dfrac{1}{t}, t - 1\right\rangle\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}(2)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har component mein \(t = 2\) rakhein: \(4\), \(\dfrac{1}{2}\), \(1\). Jawab vector hai, components ka jama \(\dfrac{11}{2}\) nahin.

book_ref.quote: takes one variable as input and returns a vector as output

blocks.prompt:
10 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\,\hat{i} - 3t\,\hat{k}\), the \(\hat{j}\)-component \(g(t)\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\,\hat{i} - 3t\,\hat{k}\) mein \(\hat{j}\)-component \(g(t)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\hat{j}\) wala term nahin, is liye \(g(t) = 0\). \(e^{t}\) \(\hat{i}\)-component aur \(-3t\) \(\hat{k}\)-component hai.

book_ref.quote: Each component of the output vector is itself a scalar function of the input

blocks.prompt:
11 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}\) with \(t > 0\), the length \(|\mathbf{r}(t)|\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}\), \(t > 0\), ki length \(|\mathbf{r}(t)|\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(|\mathbf{r}(t)| = \sqrt{9t^{2} + 16t^{2}} = 5t\) (\(t > 0\)). Length aik scalar function hai.

book_ref.quote: Each component of the output vector is itself a scalar function of the input

blocks.prompt:
12 The vector function \(\langle \sin t, t^{2}, 5\rangle\) written with unit vectors is:
(Vector function \(\langle \sin t, t^{2}, 5\rangle\) ko unit vectors ke saath kaise likhenge?)
blocks.explanation: \(\langle f, g, h\rangle = f\,\hat{i} + g\,\hat{j} + h\,\hat{k}\): tarteeb \(x, y, z\). Constant \(5\) bhi aik component hai.

book_ref.quote: are the unit vectors associated with the rectangular coordinates

blocks.prompt:
13 The first step in constructing a vector-valued function for a motion is to:
(Motion ke liye vector-valued function banane ka pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: components ko vector form mein jorna
components maloom karna (har coordinate t ke saath kaise badalta hai)

blocks.explanation: Qadam 1: components maloom karein; qadam 2: vector form mein jorein; qadam 3: domain batayein.

book_ref.quote: Identify how each coordinate changes with respect to

blocks.prompt:
14 A ball is thrown from the origin with \(v_{0} = 40\) m/s at \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\). The \(x\)-component of its position vector is:
(Aik ball origin se \(v_{0} = 40\) m/s aur \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) par phenki jati hai. Position vector ka \(x\)-component kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x = (v_{0}\cos\theta)t = 40 \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\,t = 20\sqrt{3}\,t\). Horizontal hissa \(\cos\theta\) ke saath.

book_ref.quote: horizontal motion at constant speed

blocks.prompt:
15 For the same ball (\(v_{0} = 40\) m/s, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\), \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)), the \(y\)-component is:
(Isi ball (\(v_{0} = 40\) m/s, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\), \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) ka \(y\)-component kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(y = (v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \dfrac{1}{2}gt^{2} = 20t - 4.9t^{2}\). Gravity neeche kheenchti hai, is liye minus.

book_ref.quote: vertical motion with gravity deceleration

blocks.prompt:
16 A ball thrown with \(v_{0} = 49\) m/s at \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) stays in the air for \(0 \le t \le T\). The value of \(T\) is:
(\(v_{0} = 49\) m/s, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) par phenki gayi ball \(0 \le t \le T\) hawa mein rehti hai. \(T\) kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(y = 0\) dobara jab \(t = \dfrac{2v_{0}\sin\theta}{g} = \dfrac{2(49)(0.5)}{9.8} = 5\) s. Domain \(0 \le t \le 5\).

book_ref.quote: Specify the Domain: Define the range of

blocks.prompt:
17 A drone flies on \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 4\cos t\,\hat{i} + 4\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.2t\,\hat{k}\) (metres, seconds). How much does it climb in one full turn?
(Drone \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 4\cos t\,\hat{i} + 4\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.2t\,\hat{k}\) (metre, second) par urta hai. Aik poore chakkar mein kitna oopar jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik chakkar mein \(t\) \(2\pi\) barhta hai; climb \(= 0.2 \times 2\pi = 0.4\pi \approx 1.26\) m. Radius 4 m hai, 0.2 nahin.

book_ref.quote: represents the steady ascent at 0.5 meters per second

blocks.prompt:
18 For the drone \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 4\cos t\,\hat{i} + 4\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.2t\,\hat{k}\), the position at \(t = \pi\) is:
(Drone \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 4\cos t\,\hat{i} + 4\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.2t\,\hat{k}\) ki \(t = \pi\) par position kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: represent the circular motion with a 5-meter radius

blocks.text: 11.2 Domain and Range of a Vector-Valued Function

blocks.prompt:
19 The domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln t\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{5 - t}\,\hat{j}\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln t\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{5 - t}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\ln t\) ke liye \(t > 0\); \(\sqrt{5 - t}\) ke liye \(t \le 5\). Dono: \((0, 5]\).

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
20 The domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \dfrac{1}{t + 3}\,\hat{i} + e^{t}\,\hat{j}\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \dfrac{1}{t + 3}\,\hat{i} + e^{t}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\dfrac{1}{t + 3}\) ke liye \(t \ne -3\); \(e^{t}\) har \(t\) par defined. Domain: \(-3\) ke siwa tamam real \(t\).

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
21 The domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \tan t\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{k}\) is (\(n\) an integer):
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \tan t\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{k}\) ka domain kya hai (\(n\) integer)?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan t\) wahan undefined hai jahan \(\cos t = 0\), yani \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\); component \(t\) koi shart nahin lagata.

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
22 The domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t^{2} - 9}\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j}\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t^{2} - 9}\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(t^{2} - 9 \ge 0 \Rightarrow t \le -3\) ya \(t \ge 3\). \(\pm 3\) shamil hain kyun ke \(\sqrt{0} = 0\).

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
23 If the components of \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) have domains \(D_{1}\), \(D_{2}\) and \(D_{3}\), the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ke components ke domains \(D_{1}\), \(D_{2}\), \(D_{3}\) hon to \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har component ko \(t\) par defined hona chahiye, is liye mushtarak hissa (intersection) lete hain.

book_ref.quote: is the set of all real numbers

blocks.text: 11.2.1 Steps to Find the Domain of a Vector-Valued Function

blocks.prompt:
24 The domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t + 1}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t - 2}\,\hat{j} + \ln(4 - t)\,\hat{k}\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t + 1}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t - 2}\,\hat{j} + \ln(4 - t)\,\hat{k}\) ka domain kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Find the intersection of the domains of each component

blocks.prompt:
25 The range of the component \(x(t) = \sqrt{9 - t^{2}}\) over its domain is:
(Component \(x(t) = \sqrt{9 - t^{2}}\) ki range (us ke domain par) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Determine the domain of each component separately.

blocks.prompt:
26 If \(t\) is restricted to \([3, 5]\), the values of \(y(t) = \dfrac{1}{t - 2}\) form:
(Agar \(t\) sirf \([3, 5]\) mein ho to \(y(t) = \dfrac{1}{t - 2}\) ki values kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(1 \le t - 2 \le 3 \Rightarrow \dfrac{1}{3} \le y \le 1\). Sirf domain wale \(t\) istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.prompt:
27 Which point lies in the range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\,\hat{i} + (t^{2} - 1)\,\hat{j}\)?
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\,\hat{i} + (t^{2} - 1)\,\hat{j}\) ki range mein kaun sa point hai?)
blocks.explanation: Range ke points \(y = x^{2} - 1\) par hain. \((2, 3)\): \(t = 2\) se \(y = 3\). Baaqi points is shart ko poora nahin karte.

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.prompt:
28 The range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{1 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j}\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{1 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j}\) ki range kya hai?)

options.text: unit circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) ka daayan aadha hissa, \(x \ge 0\)

blocks.explanation: Domain \([-1, 1]\). \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) aur \(x \ge 0\); \(y = t\) har value \([-1, 1]\) leta hai. Range daayen aadhe circle ke points hain.

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.text: 11.3 Identifying Scalar and Vector Valued Functions

blocks.prompt:
29 Whether a function is scalar or vector-valued is decided by:
(Function scalar hai ya vector-valued, yeh kis cheez se tay hota hai?)

options.text: kya us ka graph curve hai

blocks.explanation: Output se type tay hota hai: aik number to scalar, vector to vector-valued. Inputs ki tadaad se farq nahin parta.

book_ref.quote: Understanding the distinction between scalar and vector-valued functions is crucial

blocks.prompt:
30 The temperature in a plate is \(T(x, y, z) = 50 - x^{2} - 2y^{2} - z^{2}\). Then \(T(1, 1, 2)\) is:
(Plate ka temperature \(T(x, y, z) = 50 - x^{2} - 2y^{2} - z^{2}\) hai. \(T(1, 1, 2)\) kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(T(1, 1, 2) = 50 - 1 - 2 - 4 = 43\): aik number, is liye \(T\) scalar-valued hai.

book_ref.quote: Scalar-valued functions describe quantities like temperature or potential energy

blocks.prompt:
31 Which one of the following is vector-valued?
(In mein se kaun sa vector-valued hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\langle t, \ln t\rangle\) components ka ordered pair hai: vector. Magnitude \(\sqrt{t^{2} + 1}\) aik number hai, is liye scalar.

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions produce a vector, often written as an ordered tuple

blocks.prompt:
32 Vector-valued functions are usually written with:
(Vector-valued functions aam tor par kis tarah likhe jaate hain?)

options.text: bold letter ya arrow, maslan \(\mathbf{f}(t)\) ya \(\vec{f}(t)\)

blocks.explanation: Criterion (ii): vector-valued functions bold letter ya arrow ke saath; scalar functions saada chhote letter se.

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions are often denoted by boldface letters or with an arrow

blocks.prompt:
33 Which quantity is modelled by a scalar-valued function?
(Kaun si quantity scalar-valued function se model hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalar-valued functions temperature ya potential energy batate hain; position, velocity aur force vector-valued functions se.

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions describe quantities such as position, velocity, and force

blocks.prompt:
34 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle \sin t, \cos t, 2t\rangle\), then \(\mathbf{r}\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle \sin t, \cos t, 2t\rangle\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2} = 1\), \(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2} = 0\), \(2 \cdot \dfrac{\pi}{2} = \pi\).

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions produce a vector, often written as an ordered tuple

blocks.prompt:
35 The function \(V(x, y) = x^{2}y\) is:
(Function \(V(x, y) = x^{2}y\) kya hai?)

options.text: vector-valued, kyun ke do inputs hain
vector-valued, kyun ke point batata hai
scalar-valued, kyun ke aik number deta hai

blocks.explanation: Sirf output dekhein: \(x^{2}y\) aik real number hai (maslan \(V(2, 3) = 12\)), is liye scalar-valued.

book_ref.quote: Scalar-valued functions produce a single numerical value

blocks.prompt:
36 The derivative \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) of a vector-valued function is defined as:
(Vector-valued function ka derivative \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) kis tarah define hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Position ki tabdeeli taqseem \(\Delta t\), phir limit \(\Delta t \to 0\).

book_ref.quote: with respect to \(t\) is defined as:

blocks.prompt:
37 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + \cos t\,\hat{j} + \ln t\,\hat{k}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + \cos t\,\hat{j} + \ln t\,\hat{k}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har component ko differentiate karein aur us ka unit vector saath rakhein: \(3t^{2}\), \(-\sin t\), \(\dfrac{1}{t}\).

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
38 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{2t}\,\hat{i} + te^{t}\,\hat{j}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{2t}\,\hat{i} + te^{t}\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chain rule: \((e^{2t})' = 2e^{2t}\). Product rule: \((te^{t})' = (t + 1)e^{t}\).

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
39 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sin 3t\,\hat{i} + \cos 3t\,\hat{j}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'(0)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sin 3t\,\hat{i} + \cos 3t\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(0)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = 3\cos 3t\,\hat{i} - 3\sin 3t\,\hat{j}\); \(t = 0\) par \(3\,\hat{i}\).

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
40 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \csc t\,\hat{i} + \cot t\,\hat{j}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \csc t\,\hat{i} + \cot t\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \((\csc t)' = -\csc t\cot t = 0\) (\(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\) par); \((\cot t)' = -\csc^{2}t = -1\). Jawab \(-\hat{j}\).

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
41 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \tan^{-1} t\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{1 + t^{2}}\,\hat{j}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'(1)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \tan^{-1} t\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{1 + t^{2}}\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(1)\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
42 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \dfrac{t}{t + 1}\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'(1)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \dfrac{t}{t + 1}\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(1)\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
43 The derivative of the constant vector function \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\,\hat{i} - 5\,\hat{j} + \hat{k}\) is:
(Constant vector function \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\,\hat{i} - 5\,\hat{j} + \hat{k}\) ka derivative kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har component constant hai, us ka derivative 0; unit vectors differentiate nahin hote. \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \mathbf{0}\).

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
44 Geometrically, \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) (when it is not zero) is a vector:
(Geometry mein \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) (jab zero na ho) kaisa vector hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chord \(\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t) - \mathbf{r}(t)\) limit mein tangent ban jati hai, is liye \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) tangent ki simt mein hai.

book_ref.quote: and the limit \(\Delta t \to 0\) gives the instantaneous rate of change

blocks.prompt:
45 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\), then \(\mathbf{r}'(2)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(2)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = 2t\,\hat{i} + 3t^{2}\,\hat{j}\), phir \(t = 2\): \(4\,\hat{i} + 12\,\hat{j}\). Pehle \(t = 2\) rakhne se ghalat jawab \(\mathbf{0}\).

book_ref.quote: first differentiate each component in general, then substitute

blocks.prompt:
46 A particle has position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}\). Its velocity \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) is:
(Particle ki position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}\) hai. Velocity \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v} = \dfrac{d}{dt}\mathbf{r} = 2t\,\hat{i} + 4\,\hat{j}\).

book_ref.quote: represent the velocity vector of the particle, which is tangent to the curve

blocks.prompt:
47 If \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} - 2t^{2}\,\hat{j}\), the acceleration \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) is:
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} - 2t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ho to acceleration \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v} = 3t^{2}\,\hat{i} - 4t\,\hat{j}\); \(\mathbf{a} = 6t\,\hat{i} - 4\,\hat{j}\).

book_ref.quote: is the acceleration of the particle, denoted by

blocks.prompt:
48 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t\,\hat{i} + 2t^{2}\,\hat{j}\), the speed at \(t = 1\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t\,\hat{i} + 2t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ki \(t = 1\) par speed kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v} = 3\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}\); \(t = 1\) par \(|\mathbf{v}| = 5\). \(\sqrt{13} = |\mathbf{r}(1)|\) speed nahin.

book_ref.quote: how fast it moves, without direction

blocks.prompt:
49 At some instant \(\mathbf{v} = 6\,\hat{i} - 8\,\hat{j}\). The direction of motion \(\hat{\mathbf{v}}\) is:
(Kisi lamhe \(\mathbf{v} = 6\,\hat{i} - 8\,\hat{j}\) hai. Direction of motion \(\hat{\mathbf{v}}\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(|\mathbf{v}| = 10\); \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \dfrac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|} = \dfrac{3}{5}\,\hat{i} - \dfrac{4}{5}\,\hat{j}\).

book_ref.quote: the direction only (the unit tangent vector)

blocks.prompt:
50 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin t\,\hat{j}\), the acceleration at \(t = 0\) is:
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin t\,\hat{j}\) ka \(t = 0\) par acceleration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{a} = -5\cos t\,\hat{i} - 5\sin t\,\hat{j}\); \(t = 0\) par \(-5\,\hat{i}\), markaz ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: how the velocity is changing

blocks.prompt:
